displayName: Oracle Health Millennium Hospital Response Reference Profile

vendorSemantics.note: Oracle Health Millennium provides SMART/FHIR context plus Message Center recipients, Group Inboxes, responsible personnel and HIGH(STAT)/NORMAL(ROUTINE) message priority. Clinical activation criteria and response teams are configured by each hospital; they are not Oracle-defined numbered levels.

evidenceRules.reason: Pulseless/cardiac-arrest evidence requires immediate code/emergency response activation.
Ventricular fibrillation is an immediately life-threatening arrest rhythm and requires code/emergency response activation.
Critical deterioration meets the reference profile's rapid-response activation floor unless stronger arrest/resuscitation evidence requires code response.
Hypotension is a common rapid-response activation criterion in hospital deterioration pathways.
Low MAP indicates hemodynamic deterioration requiring rapid-response-level assessment in this reference profile.
Marked tachycardia requires urgent provider review; concurrent instability may independently raise the pathway to rapid response.
Marked bradycardia requires urgent provider review; concurrent instability may independently raise the pathway.
Significant hypoxemia meets the reference profile's rapid-response activation floor.
Marked hyperkalemia requires urgent provider evaluation; ECG/hemodynamic instability may raise the response pathway.
Marked hypokalemia requires urgent provider evaluation.
Elevated digoxin concentration requires urgent provider review.
Marked lactate elevation with deterioration warrants rapid-response-level assessment in this reference profile.
